purpose: Teach: カーボン/絶頂/アカデミック/水域/右折/前兆/全裸/盲目

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、カーボンナノチューブの応用を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, I see you explored carbon nanotubes in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, interested teacher voice. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Leans forward slightly. Inviting engagement without pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、音楽家の絶頂期の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the peak periods of musicians' careers.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No flourish. Steady eye contact. Brief pause before answering, showing she's thought through this. Calm confidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: アカデミックな評価基準を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And academic evaluation standards were central to your analysis?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measuring. Slight upward lilt on the question. Listening more than stating. Giving her room to expand on her thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、領海水域の国際法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined international maritime law and territorial waters.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. Not defensive. Maintains composure. Precise, like she's done her research and knows what she's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 交差点の右折事故統計を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: That's interesting. And you also studied right-turn accident statistics at intersections?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through. Slight lift in tone. Engaged but not presumptive — letting her confirm or correct. Teacher actively present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、地震の前兆現象研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched precursor phenomena that predict earthquakes.
lines.style: Unflinching. Each word deliberate. She's settling into her stride now. Quiet certainty in her tone, no apology in her phrasing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 全裸彫刻の美術史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You've covered quite a range. Nude sculpture in art history as well?
lines.style: Still warm. Slight smile in the voice without condescension. Acknowledging the breadth with gentle amusement. Respectful of all the topics equally.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、盲目の音楽家の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied blind musicians and their contributions to music.
lines.style: Final answer with quiet finality. No hedging. She's earned her ground. Breath settles. Looking directly at the teacher. Closes the thought cleanly.
